# dsh-locale-ja
English | 日本語
A Japanese language plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI.
## Features

- Translates the DSH Web UI into Japanese.
- Uses Japanese-friendly fallback fonts while respecting

your font settings.
- Requests Japanese AI replies when Japanese is explicitly selected. You can sti
ll ask for another reply language.
## Compatibility
Use this plugin with DSH's Web UI. Choose a compatible tag from GitHub Releases; supported DSH versi
ons and changes are recorded there and in CHANGELOG.md.
## Installation
Git and GitHub authentication with access to this private repository are required. Replace `<tag>` w
ith your selected release tag. Prebuilt files are included; no local build is needed.

the language is chosen automatically by the browser or the host cannot save the selection, such as w
